caption: NOT gate with a lever input (track gates): the lever strongly powers the stone it hangs on; a torch on top of that stone inverts it. 2 gt.

NOT gate, instant (track gates): a dust on a stone, powered by a redstone block east of it, is a straight line pointing west into the output cell; the input (south of the dust) bends it into a corner that no longer points west. Dust redirection: 0 gt.
OR gate with lever inputs (track gates): both levers hang on one stone and strongly power it; the output cell above the stone sees it. 0 gt, one block.

OR gate, instant (track gates): one dust on a stone between the two inputs; either input powers the dust, the dust powers the stone under it, and the output cell under the stone sees it. 0 gt. (With the output cell itself between the inputs the OR needs no block at all.)
NOR gate with lever inputs (track gates): both levers hang on the same stone and strongly power it; a torch on top of the stone is lit only when neither lever is on. 2 gt.

NOR gate, instant (track gates): a dust on a stone, powered by a redstone block south of it, is a straight line pointing north into the output cell; either input (west, east) bends it into a corner or a T that no longer points north. Dust redirection: 0 gt.

NIMPLY gate a AND NOT b, instant (track gates): one dust on a stone between the two inputs; input a (south of the dust) powers it, and alone it is a straight line that points north into the output cell; input b (east of the dust) bends it into a corner (south + east) that no longer points north. Dust redirection: 0 gt.

NIMPLY gate b AND NOT a, instant (track gates): the mirror of gate-nimply-2b (inputs swapped): one dust on a stone; input b alone makes it a line pointing into the output cell, input a bends it into a corner. Dust redirection: 0 gt.

IMPLY gate a -> b, instant (track gates): a dust on a stone, powered by a redstone block east of it, is a straight line pointing west into the output cell (NOT a); input a (north of the dust) bends it into a corner; input b touches the output cell (OR b). Dust redirection: 0 gt.

IMPLY gate b -> a, instant (track gates): the mirror of gate-imply-3b (inputs swapped): a dust pointing into the output cell from a redstone block (NOT b), bent away by input b; input a touches the output cell (OR a). 0 gt.

XOR gate, instant (track gates): one dust on a stone between input a (west) and input b (north), with a stone east of it and a stone south of it, and the output cell touching both stones. a alone makes the dust a west-east line pointing into the east stone, b alone a north-south line pointing into the south stone (either stone powers the output); both bend it into a corner that points into neither. Dust redirection: 0 gt.

AND gate (track gates): two subtract comparators. The first reads a constant redstone block at its back and input b at its side: 15 - b = NOT b, into the side of the second, which reads input a at its back: a - NOT b = a AND b. 4 gt (two comparators).
